title: Deep learning triages suspected COVID-19 on chest CT and tracks lesion burden
summary: A U-Net-based model trained on chest CT scans from 2447 patients (1647 PCR-confirmed COVID-19) segments lung opacities and flags COVID-19 imaging manifestations. In an external set of 2120 consecutive cases from three fever clinics, triage AUC was 0.953 with sensitivity 0.923 and specificity 0.851, and the AI flagged cases in a median of 0.55 minutes. For lesion-burden increase it reached sensitivity 0.962 and specificity 0.875, with high agreement with a radiologist panel (kappa 0.839). The study is retrospective and from early in the pandemic.
